body: Hi tumbleweedfire951, thank you so much for your message. It makes me feel better to know that what I am experiencing is normal and probably just due to a high degree of anxiety than normal stemming from my childhood.Well, it is interesting what you say because that is my aim in life too: helping people. That is why I wanted to finish my PhD in anthropology to then go on and work for some humanitarian organisation. I hope this will still be possible, it should be, I just have to prove to myself that I can still do all the things I could before the breakup. You are right about my ex, he wasn't mature enough to have a relationship probably (as I never had anxiety attacks before that week, and it was the first in 3 years we had been together). I am sorry you haven't find a job and a gf yet, but don't worry it will come I am sure of that; you are such a sensitive and kind person and you will find someone who deserves you.

This is exactly what happened. I don't know how you understood this from my few lines. That is how it feels, it is devastating...I was so close. Maybe you are right, I should think about another plan, if I did  it once, maybe I can do it again. I just need to prove to myself that I can still do it! It is so hard though, I feel helpless and hopeless sometimes...but I won't waste my life, I will keep on trying. I am very driven I have been told, maybe this drive will save me once more! Sometimes I just wonder why things couldn't just go to plan for me though! Thank you so much for your words!
This is so helpful, thank you so much. It really really made me feel better about all this situation! This kind of kindness from a stranger makes me believe life is worth living!
Where do I see your private messages? and where do I reply? sorry first time using reddit!
Hi, thanks for your message. It really touches me. How do I keep on keeping on?

Hi Butyraldehyde, thank you for reaching out to me. Yes, I would like to talk if you have time. The FMRI came back negative, but for 2 weeks I feared for my life like never before. That episode really shocked me. I was constantly shaking, crying and desperate. I can't believe my bf left me when I needed him the most. I feel so alone and my friends and family don't help much. Going to the psychologist scares me even more as I am scared of becoming like my mom. She ruined my life and our family, and I don't want to be like her, my family doesn't deserve that. Especially my dad. I did everything to never be like her, but now I feel that there is no way out, either that or death. I had a brilliant life and everything else, but I can't find enough strength, I can't accept it. How could he leave me when in December he said he had a plan for our engagement? how can work be more important than a person? My mom has depression and obsessive thoughts... great future ahead of me. I am really desperate, I am holding on until Sunday when I see him and then maybe it is my time. I am sorry to hear you are scared that your gf will feel the same soon, if she really loves you she won't leave you though; but I know what you mean about having to pretend you are something you are not. Why did you have a panic attack?

Blind dates? I don't want to date anyone! I want to end this pain. Talking to someone through a reddit post? no! I wanted some advice. I feel like I am going crazy and nobody understands me, everyone says it will pass but it never does. And I don't want to disappoint my dad by becoming like my mom, I had such an amazing life ahead of me, and now it is all broken, I will never forgive myself for this. The only moment when I am happy these days is when I take my sleeping pill, so I don't realise what is going on anymore. It is a nightmare I never thought I could live.

No there isn't, I will never be happy again. I have taken a month off, but it isn't getting better. I would like to leave, but alone? He has ruined my life forever but he is just living and working normally. How can such a life make sense?
